spans.s: halā, vc. pcl. used in addressing a female 🞄friend on the stage.
halāhala, m. n. kind of deadly poison.
hālāhala, m. (rare), n. a kind of 🞄deadly poison.

hal-in, m. ploughman, agriculturist;
 🞄ep. of Balarāma (± rāma).

hallīśa, m. kind of one-act drama performed 🞄by one man and seven or eight woman;
 🞄n. dance performed by women led by a man.
